text: Rolled out on owner approval: local main c436d7ee (no push) adds tools/build/sbt-warm and an AGENTS.md Build & test note; Fray broadcast seq 1047. Kept: warm per-worktree sbt server (gate 65s median cold -> ~1s warm), per-worktree global base cloned copy-on-write from a pin-keyed template (no shared staging, no global lock needed), 4 processors for loading, 3-slot host semaphore, 30-min idle shutdown. Dropped: AppCDS, ParallelGC (no measured gain). Deferred by owner: H3 binary pins (only shortens one-time first boot per worktree; blockers: multivar test->test dependency, ravel stencil/packed publish skip, nested SNAPSHOT coordinates, two gale revisions). Experiment worktrees /private/tmp/scalafim-buildperf (branch perf/build-throughput-20261001) and /private/tmp/scalafim-buildperf-b (detached) remain for reference.
